features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION DOES NOT TOUCH THE DATABASE. It corrects the requirements the program declares: anyone installing from scratch onto an incomplete hosting environment is now stopped at the door instead of finding out afterwards.

THE MISSING EXTENSION WAS THE ONE THE REPORTS NEED — The program did not ask for the PHP «gd» extension, which the engine behind every PDF relies on: breakdowns, instalment schedules, statements of account, tax forms. On hosting without it, installation succeeded, everything was configured, and then every single report failed. That is the worst way for a requirement to be missing, because it blocks after the fact rather than at the door. «gd» is now required, along with «intl» and «mbstring», which were also missing.

THE UPDATE TELLS YOU BEFOREHAND, NOT AFTER YOU CLICK — The «Update management» page offered the new version and a button; the requirements check ran after the click. Nothing broke — the check happens before a single file is written, and the installation stayed intact — but you were offered something your server could not install, and found out by trying. Now, if something is missing, you read it next to the offered version: which PHP is needed and which you have, which extensions are missing and where to enable them. The button stays disabled until it is sorted out. And for the first time extensions are checked on update too: previously only a fresh installation looked at them, so anyone updating on hosting without «gd» went through and then could no longer print.

THE VERSION GATE HAD THE WRONG NUMBER — The declared minimum PHP version was 8.4.0 in one place and 8.2.0 in another, while the program will not start below 8.4.1. An administrator on PHP 8.2 or 8.3 would have passed the check and ended up with an installation that does not boot. The threshold is now the real one, and it is the same everywhere. Anyone below it sees a message saying so, before a single file is written.

AND THE PROGRAM NOW NOTICES BY ITSELF — There were three requirement lists, hand-written in three different places, and they had drifted apart without anyone touching them: all it takes is one library raising its own floor. An automatic check now redoes the calculation by reading the dependencies actually installed, and blocks the release if one of the lists has fallen behind — or if it asks for more than necessary, which would turn away hosting the program runs on perfectly well.
